description: Repairs r-sort-3b/dao-index-flags: after CREATE TABLE through Execute, TableDefs.Item("DX2" to "DX7") failed with 0x800A0CC1 because TableDefs was not refreshed, so only DX1 got an index and 6 of the 7 flag variants were never exercised; DX1's Primary read back as 0; the inserts ran with no options. Fixture (General ACCDB). 7 tables (S Counter, K TEXT(20), N Long) with no key, each variant in its own read/write open of the closed file with an image kept after it: the table is created (dbFailOnError), TableDefs is refreshed before Item, DAO index IX is created with TableDef.CreateIndex, one CreateField per column and the properties (Primary, Unique, Required, IgnoreNulls): (K) primary+IgnoreNulls; (K, N) primary; (K, N) unique+IgnoreNulls; (K, N) unique+Required; (K) IgnoreNulls; (K) Required; (K, N) Required+IgnoreNulls. DBEngine.Errors is read after Indexes.Append, Indexes is refreshed, then six INSERTs per table over the tuples (Null, Null), (a, Null), (a, 1), (Null, 1), (a, 1), (Null, Null), one per statement with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors after each; then the surviving S of the table and its refreshed index metadata (Primary, Unique, Required, IgnoreNulls, DistinctCount, fields) are read. Asks which property combinations DAO admits on an empty table, what each reads back as, and which inserts each combination refuses.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
